reels.caption:
🍂Save this before you book your Mexico beach trip 💾

🌊 Everyone is asking if Mexico is ruined by the sargassum seaweed right now, and the truth is it depends entirely on which coast you book.

The Caribbean side (Cancun, Tulum, Playa del Carmen and the Riviera Maya) is getting hit hard this year with one of the worst sargassum seasons on record. The seaweed comes from the Sargasso Sea but this year there are also massive blooms in the Gulf of Guinea that move west

But Cabo sits on the Sea of a Cortez and the Pacific side of Mexico, a completely different ocean, so the seaweed literally cannot reach it.

Clean sand, deep blue water, no seaweed season.

If you saved all year for your dream trip, don't book the nightmare by mistake. Come to THIS side of Mexico instead.

Is Cabo affected by sargassum? No. Is there seaweed in Cabo? No. Best seaweed free beaches in Mexico? Cabo.

Follow me for all things Cabo 🌵

📍 Cabo San Lucas, Mexico
